property_summary: For all inputs, the reference contract requires that the _tos array is non-empty, so calling transfer(...) with an empty _tos array will revert (fail); the mutant removes that require and will instead succeed and return true for empty arrays, violating the rule.
change_summary: Remove the require that _tos.length > 0 so calls with empty arrays succeed and return true, changing observable behavior for empty input.
